overview: FAM4202 is a flight event focused on hydraulic system. The notes below are organized off the canonical syllabus items first, then filled out with local FAM gouge so students can brief the event, explain the why behind each item, and stay ahead of instructor follow-up questions.

children.text: Know what Hydraulic System changes in the cockpit and why the instructor cares about it in this event.
pull to return fluid from em. Accumulator to reservoir
Fluid level must show full AC or full AD
Function:
Houses the reservoir, pump, and pressure generation/control elements for the main hydraulic system.
Key Components:
Main gear actuators
Nose gear actuator
Inboard gear doors actuators
Gear up = doors close
Gear down = doors open and stay open
(W) If NWS fails, disengage and use differential braking to stop—don’t taxi with known steering issues
Pressure sent to speed brake actuator when extended
Automatically retracted when power = MAX or flaps extended
Hyde pressure keeps it UP (droop on the ramp when not pressurized)
(N) If the emergency accumulator is discharged (T-Handle), EHYD PX LO will illuminate until the Emergency system pressurizes. Ensure light has extinguished prior to flight
Landing gear position irrelevant when using emergency system
